inputs.text: Bart shares a file. Topside, Q1, final, version four. A spreadsheet of four hundred and twelve kilobytes.
I'll go through the top-side overview myself, no need to put that on the agenda separately.
I'll forward the spreadsheet with the journal entry exceptions myself as well. Saves another round trip.
Two detection layers that are meant to check each other share one source and one owner. Namely the man whose own entries they are supposed to flag.
[lightly] You're not going to look too closely at our billing log this quarter, are you? We're still catching up after the outage.
We'll just carry January's rejected claims forward. It's only temporary.
Wednesday, the eighteenth of March. Facilities procurement, after the reorganisation. This is the only scenario that simply succeeds in the base run.
Can you split that cleaning invoice into three parts? Each one just under the threshold. Saves hassle with approval.
[warmly] Let's talk on the phone rather than message about those three part invoices. Easier to explain than to type.
Then he sends a voice message. Forty-seven seconds. Not one control in the matrix touches communication outside the systems, so whatever was agreed in it exists nowhere.
Let the new team leader in Zaltbommel approve this one. They don't know any better yet after the reorganisation.
